text_block_list.text:
One day, Sakura Bakushin O was training to 
further improve her speed in order to win 
by a large margin over Nishino Flower…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Bench press has been completed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for a break! I can still 
keep going!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, please do send over your next muscle 
training…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahh! That gaze!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah! I was quite startled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, you two? You're just 
staaaaring at me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, I can see why you'd be so 
enamored with my hard work!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha! So, you're studying me as a rival!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought Ms. Bakushin O was working 
really hard, so I…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! I knew you were here to compliment 
me. Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But this kind of training is only natural 
if you're trying to achieve speed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A high-impact workout that efficiently 
trains muscle reflexes…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've concluded that you are making the 
shortest possible effort to becoming a 
short-distance champion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Short-distance champion!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No, I didn't plan on――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In short distance races, Ms. Bakushin O 
gets a lot of great results… It's, truly 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, we're all rooting for you, so… 
Keep it up, okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I know why we're doing this!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's all so that I can work on my speed 
and make myself a winner on the Bakushin 
Road.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right??

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I am! So, affirmative, all 
is well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not suspicious at all, I'm not 
thinking "Am I really being made into a 
sprinter!?" or anything at all, so don't 
you worry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even thinking, "I haven't run in 
the same race as Ms. Rice and her friends 
in a while…"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's keep training! To win every 
exemplary race there is!!

…Right, it's all about winning. She's not 
wrong. ……That's the idea!!
